title: Bounded Copilot interactive CLI and retired runtime qualification
boundary: A source-bound local-fixture increment, not real GitHub consent/entitlement, complete profile/lifecycle acceptance, a full distribution/build-context manifest, or ChatGPT/Codex implementation.
changes: Explicit interactive issuer distinct from storage label; encrypted guarded publication starts before device transport; five-minute/device expiry and caller/host cancellation.
Canonical login makes the native adapter available without selecting it; foreign labels stay passive; no API-key factory flattening or implicit model/subscription policy activation.

Provider runtime close/parent/caller signals retire subscription resolution and refresh across reload/shutdown; RPC receives native subscription composition and preserves owned startup signal disposition.
The device client settles abort despite uncooperative fetch and abandons late bodies; process-global fetch is not replaced by production code.
The existing TLS/PTY scenario is reused for emitted/installed regular/fullscreen; its installed headless branches cover print/JSON/RPC login/inference/journal/logout refusal.
